//: Capability manifest for <ProfileButton> (the .pc-navbar__profile-btn trigger) — svelte-pure-admin. ProfileButton.svelte renders <button class="pc-navbar__profile-btn {class}" aria-label={a11y.userProfile → "User Profile"}> with a .pa-btn__icon wrapper (default .pa-icon.pa-icon--user, or the `icon` snippet) and a .pc-navbar__profile-name span when `name` is set. Shared SSR features: the name string (→ name span) + the root class passthrough. The custom `icon` snippet is a shared slot, defaulted in the goldens.
